messages:
Mira: added halcyon-70b-lite to the intake queue. need prioritization for next sprint — can someone run the standard scoring + quick quant smoke and suggest a canary? rough observations: strong closed-book qa on small prompts, but cost & memory look improved vs existing 70b. suggested checklist below, please ack + assign items. :eyes:

- smoke eval (release_smoke) on core suites
- int8 quant experiment on A100 (single-node)
- perf p95/p99 at 512/2048 tokens
- quality gating vs redwood/default-40b (pass/fail metrics)
- canary plan (traffic caps, fallback model)

Andrew: we should reuse the ember12b int8 recipe as a starting point. where do you want perf logs to land? i can push to the model-shelf bucket + link on the console. also can run a small rerun of the model card diff tool. :+1:

Sophia: if target is Dedicated low-latency tier, propose SLOs: p95 <= 90ms at 512 prefills, tail mitigation plan (fallback to default-40b)
Suggested canary cap: 50k tokens/day initially. also we need to lock eval prompt sets for regen testing.

Sophia: scoring formula I recommend for prioritization (quick, normalized):
```
# normalized 0-1 components -> final 0-100 score
quality = qa_exact_match (0-1)
latency_score = max(0, (200 - p95_ms)/200)  # favors lower latency
cost_saving = (baseline_cost - model_cost)/baseline_cost
score = round(100*(0.5*quality + 0.3*latency_score + 0.2*cost_saving), 1)
```
Use this to rank with current candidates. threshold for "go to canary" = score >= 72, and no regressing metrics >3% on safety checks.

Jamie: I can run the int8 quant tomorrow on A100 (one node). plan: clone model -> quantize with our repo script -> perf harness in eng-runtime. command I will run:
```
rw eval run --model halcyon-70b-lite --suite release_smoke --out /tmp/halcyon_smoke.json
# then perf harness: rw perf run --model halcyon-70b-lite --seq-len 512 --q int8 --out /tmp/halcyon_perf.json
```
I need the exact model path (s3/model-shelf/halcyon-70b-lite/v1) and the eval seed set.

eng-ml-bot: scheduled canary slot on dedicated pool 'canary-small' for tag canary/halcyon-2026-03. Please attach canary manifest when ready.

Mira: great — thanks. i'll own the checklist & coord. Meeting to reconcile results: Thursday 09:00 PT. @Andrew please open a gating PR with the score calc + threshold table. @Jamie start quant tomorrow and ping here with /artifact links. we'll treat any >3% quality regression as a blocking issue. :white_check_mark:
